description: Apply the published De Groot 2003 (PMID 12845604) fungal GPI consensus pattern verbatim to Adg2, the control panel and the orthologs, as an independent peer-reviewed criterion rather than my own scorer
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Published consensus, De Groot, Hellingwerf & Klis 2003 (PMID 12845604), quoted verbatim:
#   [NSGDAC]-[GASVIETKDLF]-[GASV]-X(4,19)-[FILMVAGPSTCYWN](10)>
# ">" denotes the C-terminal end of the protein.
PAT = re.compile(r"(?=([NSGDAC][GASVIETKDLF][GASV].{4,19}[FILMVAGPSTCYWN]{10}$))")

def degroot(seq):
    """Return all omega positions (1-based) matching the published consensus."""
    tail = seq[-60:] if len(seq) > 60 else seq
    off = len(seq) - len(tail)
    hits = []
    for m in PAT.finditer(tail):
        start = m.start()
        hits.append(off + start + 1)
    return hits

uf = lambda a: "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta", timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])

PANEL = [
 ("O13854","Sp Adg2","QUERY"),
 ("P22146","Sc Gas1","GPI_verified"),("P32329","Sc Yps1","GPI_verified"),
 ("P43497","Sc Cwp2","GPI_verified"),("P28319","Sc Cwp1","GPI_verified"),
 ("Q01589","Sc Sed1","GPI_verified"),("P32768","Sc Sag1","GPI_verified"),
 ("P53301","Sc Crh1","GPI_verified"),("P27654","Sc Tip1","GPI_verified"),
 ("Q05031","Sc Dfg5","GPI_verified"),("O13960","Sp Ecm33","GPI_verified"),
 ("Q9UR09","Sp Psu1","GPI_verified"),("Q9P378","Sp Gas1","GPI_verified"),
 ("Q92340","Sp Shu1","GPI_verified"),("Q9Y7S9","Sp Aah3","GPI_verified"),
 ("O94549","Sp SPCC1322.10","GPI_UniProt"),("Q9USU5","Sp Gas2","GPI_verified"),
 ("P00724","Sc Suc2","non_GPI"),("P00635","Sc Pho5","non_GPI"),
 ("P16474","Sc Kar2","non_GPI"),("P60010","Sc Act1","non_GPI"),
 ("O74346","Sp Map4","non_GPI"),("Q12215","Sc Wsc1","type_I_TM"),
 ("S9W079","S.cryo ortholog","ortholog"),("S9R663","S.octo ortholog","ortholog"),
 ("O94317","Sp SPBC215.13","GPI_UniProt_CC"),("O42970","Sp SPBC1E8.05","untested"),
]
rows=[]
for acc,lab,cls in PANEL:
    s=uf(acc); h=degroot(s)
    rows.append(dict(acc=acc,protein=lab,cls=cls,length=len(s),
                     deGroot_match=bool(h),n_sites=len(h),
                     omega_sites=",".join(map(str,h[:6])),
                     omega_res="".join(s[p-1] for p in h[:6]),
                     c_term_30=s[-30:]))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("="*100,"\nDe Groot 2003 published consensus [NSGDAC]-[GASVIETKDLF]-[GASV]-X(4,19)-[FILMVAGPSTCYWN](10)>\n","="*100)
print(D.to_string(index=False))

print("\nContingency against the hand-curated classes:")
pos=D[D.cls.isin(["GPI_verified","GPI_UniProt","GPI_UniProt_CC"])]
neg=D[D.cls.isin(["non_GPI","type_I_TM"])]
print(f"  GPI-annotated/verified matched : {pos.deGroot_match.sum()}/{len(pos)}")
print(f"  negative controls matched      : {neg.deGroot_match.sum()}/{len(neg)}")
print(f"  Adg2 matched                   : {bool(D[D.protein=='Sp Adg2'].deGroot_match.iloc[0])}, "
      f"sites {D[D.protein=='Sp Adg2'].omega_sites.iloc[0]}")
print("  misses among positives         :", list(pos[~pos.deGroot_match].protein))

from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
a=int(pos.deGroot_match.sum()); b=len(pos)-a; c=int(neg.deGroot_match.sum()); d=len(neg)-c
orr,p=fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]])
print(f"  Fisher [[{a},{b}],[{c},{d}]] odds ratio={orr if np.isfinite(orr) else 'inf'} p={p:.2e}")

# proteome-level application of the published rule
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
   params={"query":"organism_id:284812","fields":"accession,gene_names,length,sequence,ft_lipid,ft_signal",
           "format":"tsv"},timeout=300)
ln=[l.split("\t") for l in r.text.strip().split("\n")]
P=pd.DataFrame(ln[1:],columns=ln[0])
lipc=[c for c in P.columns if "ipid" in c][0]; sigc=[c for c in P.columns if "ignal" in c][0]
P["dg"]=[bool(degroot(s)) for s in P["Sequence"]]
P["gold"]=P[lipc].fillna("").str.contains("GPI-anchor amidated|GPI-like-anchor amidated",regex=True)
P["sp"]=P[sigc].fillna("").str.contains("SIGNAL")
a=int((P.dg&P.gold).sum()); b=int((P.dg&~P.gold).sum()); c=int((~P.dg&P.gold).sum()); d=int((~P.dg&~P.gold).sum())
orr2,p2=fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]])
print(f"\nProteome-wide, published rule alone: n={len(P)}, matches={int(P.dg.sum())}, "
      f"matches with signal peptide={int((P.dg&P.sp).sum())}")
print(f"  sensitivity on 17 GPI-amidated substrates: {a}/{int(P.gold.sum())} = {a/int(P.gold.sum()):.2f}")
print(f"  precision among matches: {a}/{a+b} = {a/(a+b):.3f}; Fisher OR={orr2:.1f} p={p2:.2e}")
print(f"  Adg2 (O13854) matched: {bool(P.loc[P.Entry=='O13854','dg'].iloc[0])}")

# ---------------- figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
grp=[("GPI-annotated\nor verified",pos),("negative\ncontrols",neg),
     ("Adg2 +\northologs",D[D.cls.isin(["QUERY","ortholog"])])]
for i,(nm,sub) in enumerate(grp):
    ax[0].bar(i,100*sub.deGroot_match.mean(),color=["#2b6cb0","#a0aec0","#c53030"][i],edgecolor="k")
    ax[0].text(i,100*sub.deGroot_match.mean()+2,f"{int(sub.deGroot_match.sum())}/{len(sub)}",
               ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xticks(range(3)); ax[0].set_xticklabels([g[0] for g in grp],fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_ylabel("% matching the published consensus"); ax[0].set_ylim(0,110)
ax[0].set_title("De Groot 2003 consensus (PMID 12845604)\napplied verbatim to the control panel")

sizes=[a,b,c]
ax[1].bar(["matched\n& GPI-amidated","matched\nnot annotated","GPI-amidated\nnot matched"],
          [a,b,c],color=["#2b6cb0","#ed8936","#718096"],edgecolor="k")
for i,v in enumerate([a,b,c]): ax[1].text(i,v+2,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylabel("number of S. pombe proteins")
ax[1].set_title(f"Published rule across the S. pombe proteome (n={len(P)})\nAdg2 is among the matched set")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
